additional_info.subject: RE: ID0389021-DC/Si-D/TR-[Y2/RN 313392372001] "Income_Phaseloss" error CRM:00579001297
additional_info.body:
Hello Mert,
Greetings of the day!
We found the following error flag:
Hence, we need to check the following connections of MCCB QA1:
Please make sure that the charger is shutdown - and wait some minutes - before working in this area!!!
Check correct voltages at income copper bars in front of MCCB, after MCCB/in front of EMC filter, after EMC filter to identify root cause
We need to check for the Aux Contactors of the MCCB.
We suggest having the spare Aux. Switch 3VA Changeover Contact and MCCB (QA1) itself as well while being onsite, if any replacement is required.
Also check phase cables on all converters, whether they are connected properly or if any loose connection? Replug the loose wires, if found any.
**Disclaimer**
"The above mentioned steps need to be carefully carried out by Siemens service engineer or Any trained and certified engineer on this product. Following the 5 electrical safety rules "
Disconnect from the mains
Secure against reconnection
Verify that the system is dead
Carry out earthing and short circuiting
Provide protection from adjacent live parts.
Thank you
Best Regards
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vaishnavi Raut
